tasks.short: Evaluate food operations and develop quality-assurance programs.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual food processing/storage records, specifications and quality requirements
inputs: actual processing/storage operations and evaluation scope
actual logs, test results and current requirements
outputs: checked actual operations evidence and requirements

steps.what: Evaluate actual processing and storage operations, controls, deviations and food-quality risks
inputs: checked actual operations evidence and requirements
actual observed operations and control performance
outputs: actual evaluation findings and unresolved quality risks

steps.what: Develop actual quality-assurance program recommendations with responsible operations and quality owners
inputs: actual evaluation findings and unresolved quality risks
actual operational constraints and owner feedback
outputs: actual chosen quality-assurance recommendations and conditions

steps.what: Record and check final evaluation findings and quality-assurance recommendations
inputs: actual evaluation findings and unresolved quality risks
actual chosen quality-assurance recommendations and conditions
outputs: checked final evaluation/program recommendation record and permitted recipients

steps.what: Save checked final operations evaluation and quality-assurance recommendation record
inputs: checked final evaluation/program recommendation record and permitted recipients

steps.what: Deliver exact checked evaluation and recommendations to actual responsible quality owners
inputs: checked final evaluation/program recommendation record and permitted recipients
outputs: actual evaluation/recommendations delivered for owner decision

tasks.design: Configure native operation-to-log and requirement links in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. Retain actual food-operation evaluation, program development and full findings capture/check, followed by separate save and delivery through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evaluations can repeat navigation to actual records and applicable requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native operation/source links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Actual process risks and effective quality controls need scientific and operational judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises when documented compliance fails to reflect actual operating practice.
tasks.altitude: Less source retrieval; food-quality judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native log/requirement links can support food-operation evaluations; they do not observe operations or establish safe quality controls.

assumptions: Actual operations/test owners produce logs and measurements; actual quality owners supply approved requirements. Scientist checks them in s1 and produces actual field findings in retained s2. No unperformed observation is inferred from a plan.

S3 retains actual program decisions; s4 retains new findings/recommendation capture and complete final checking. Delivery is an internal recommendation, not program enactment. Actual program approval/implementation is a distinct exact-final-program gated action with owner authority and no avoided labour claimed.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native links first; existing access earns zero saving. Save/delivery each retain one percent using existing final checking. Actual written record only where required; remove unused branch and reweight.
unknowns: Which source navigation repeats beyond existing quality views?
research_questions: Can native links reduce retrieval after full operational and requirement checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual operations/log and approved-requirement links.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final evaluation/recommendation record and exact record destination; edits require recheck
s4 exact final evaluation/recommendations and authorised quality/operations recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 retrieval = 8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.5. Half eligible gives 4 minus 0.5 = 3.5. Actual evaluation, program development, complete capture/check and save/delivery retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Demonstrate actual food products to clients.

steps.what: Find and verify actual product specification, permitted claims and demonstration requirements
inputs: actual product and client demonstration request
actual product specifications and approved handling/claim information

steps.what: Prepare and demonstrate actual products, explain properties and answer client questions
inputs: checked actual demonstration context
actual product samples, equipment and client questions
outputs: actual product demonstration and observed client feedback

steps.what: Record and check actual client feedback and chosen follow-up where required
inputs: actual product demonstration and observed client feedback

steps.what: Save checked actual client demonstration and feedback record
inputs: checked final actual demonstration/feedback record

tasks.design: Configure native client/product links in {CRM} and {DOCS}. Retain actual sample preparation, physical demonstration, client questions and any required new feedback capture/check before a separate record save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Demonstration preparation can repeat product-source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native client/product links can reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Physical product performance and client understanding require actual demonstration.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist responds to unexpected product behaviour and the client's real application concerns.
tasks.altitude: Less product lookup; demonstrations stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native product/client source links can support demonstrations; they do not prepare samples or demonstrate actual food properties.

assumptions: Actual product owners supply specifications and approved claims; client supplies actual needs. Scientist checks applicability in s1. All physical sample handling and explanation remain retained in s2.

S3 captures actual feedback after the demonstration, not inferred from a booking. Record only if actually required; otherwise remove and reweight. Any actual written client follow-up is a separate exact-final-content gated send; no avoided send labour claimed.
Shares are provisional, not measured. Preparation counted once per actual new demonstration, not per attendee. Existing links earn zero saving; save retains one percent using existing final checking.
unknowns: Which product-source navigation is actually repeated?
research_questions: Can native links reduce preparation while retaining actual demonstration and feedback?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual feedback record and exact client/demonstration destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 source navigation = 6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Half eligible gives 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5. Physical demonstration, actual feedback capture/check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Seek substitutes for harmful or undesirable food additives.

steps.what: Find and check actual evidence on additive functions, candidate substitutes and application constraints
inputs: actual food formulation and undesirable additive concern
actual literature, formulation records and approved requirements
outputs: checked actual candidate evidence and unresolved questions

steps.what: Assess candidate substitutes and perform actual formulation, safety, stability and sensory research
inputs: checked actual candidate evidence and unresolved questions
actual formulations, test materials and approved study methods
outputs: actual candidate test results and scientifically chosen conclusions

steps.what: Record and check actual substitute research findings using verified study and ingredient fields
inputs: actual candidate test results and scientifically chosen conclusions
actual study identifiers and ingredient records
outputs: checked final actual substitute research record

steps.what: Commit checked final actual additive-substitute research record
inputs: checked final actual substitute research record
outputs: saved actual substitute findings and limitations

tasks.design: Configure native formulation/literature links in {DATA_PLATFORM} and {DOCS}, with repeated study identifiers in the laboratory module of {OPS_SYSTEM}. Retain actual candidate assessment, experiments and new-result capture/check before a separate findings commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Substitute research can repeat source retrieval and stable study/ingredient entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and study fields can reduce repeated administration.
tasks.still_hard: A substitute must preserve relevant safety and product functions in the actual formulation.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises that replacing an undesirable additive may introduce a different safety or stability failure.
tasks.altitude: Less research administration; substitution science stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native formulation/source links and study fields can assist additive-substitute research; they do not establish a substitute's safety or suitability.

assumptions: Actual literature and formulation owners provide source evidence; scientist checks relevance, reads substance and evaluates candidates. S1 reduces source navigation only, not full scientific reading or appraisal.

All actual experiments, observations and measured results are produced in retained s2. S3 reduces stable study/ingredient copying only; new findings, limitations and complete scientific/source checking remain. No replacement formulation is released or manufacturing specification changed here; actual change requires its own final-formulation gated approval/action.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native functions first; existing fields earn zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing final checking. No blanket claim that a named additive is unsafe or that a particular substitute works is made.
unknowns: Which literature navigation and study fields actually repeat?
research_questions: Can native links reduce administration after full scientific reading and result checking?

incremental.description: Maintain actual formulation/source links and study fields.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual substitute findings/limitations and exact study-record destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25*0.50 source navigation + 19*0.20 repeated fields = 16.3; minus 1 upkeep = 15.3. Half eligible gives 8.15 minus 1 = 7.15. Scientific reading, experiments, new capture, complete final checks and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Food scientists retain safety and product judgement while actual source retrieval and repeated fields may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual repeated administration while preserving scientific reading, testing and operational decisions.
